# Array consumer carrier result

A Java 8 generic provider binds one original array component to a lower-bounded
binary comparator and the invariant result carrier. Primitive indices retain
their original words. Source/SDK routes preserve the inherited facade call and
compile every generated Java unit. The unchanged compiler output and immutable
observers cover five dispatch routes, array covariance, partial writes,
callback mutations, class initialization, exact failures and result identity.
Signature-only controls and separate wrong programs challenge each relation.
